# DS → native-Rete / IR lowering

How DS source text compiles
to the native Rete network: schemas to schema-metadata
atoms and alpha nodes, rules to terminal nodes, patterns and
`where` clauses to alpha/beta nodes and join tests, actions
to the terminal's actions and `Expr` calls ([RDSC.4a.8], [RDSC.4a.9]),
series and companion slots to compile-time registrations plus
aggregation calls. Covers the synthetic-name
convention, dialect-driven per-tier differences, compile-time
validation and error shape, and string-interpolation lowering.
The Rete network is the program.

## What this is not

- Not a language-semantics spec — see language docs.
- Not a compiler-internals guide (AST, pass
  ordering, IR choices are implementation).
- Not the Rete-engine internals spec — see
  [IRET].
- Not an artefact-format spec — `ruleset_hash`
  references the artefact; its internal structure
  is implementation.
